train_dual_crnn_modifications.init_scale_reason: Prevents FP16 overflow (max 65,504) during CTC loss backpropagation through 7 CNN layers and 2 BiLSTM layers on Tesla T4 GPUs.
train_dual_crnn_modifications.fallback_decoder: Wraps ctc_greedy_decode in try/except TypeError so it works identically whether input_lengths is accepted or not.
